verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Bills API lets you create/manage vendor invoices programmatically, and AgentOS is a toolkit for AI agents to act on the account (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, building cashflow reports), which could theoretically be composed into a bill-reading workflow. However, there is no direct documentation of an AI/OCR capability that reads incoming bill documents and auto-populates payment details for review. missing for 10: explicit OCR/document-extraction feature for bills, evidence of auto-population of payment fields from scanned/received invoices, and any hands-on demonstration of this AP workflow.
